subject.title: v2026.6.x system prompt bloat causes instruction following degradation on smaller models

question: What product direction should OpenClaw take for smaller-model runs where v2026.6 prompt growth and activated skill content compete with user or workspace instructions?
rationale: The remaining fix could be prompt-priority wording, model-aware defaults, lean-mode expansion, skill-content scoping, bootstrap budget changes, or a broader context compactor; choosing among those changes public runtime behavior and compatibility.

options.title: Design model-aware prompt priority and scoping
options.body: Keep this issue open as the runtime/product decision point and require a maintainer-approved policy plus live smaller-model proof before implementation.

options.title: Limit scope to existing lean-mode workaround
options.body: Treat current opt-in lean mode and docs as the supported mitigation, and ask reporters for fresh current-main evidence before further core work.

options.title: Move only broad compaction to the existing feature issue
options.body: Close this as a duplicate of the context-compactor feature only if maintainers decide the skill/protocol regression adds no unique bug acceptance criteria.

recommendation.title: Design model-aware prompt priority and scoping
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the runtime/product decision point and require a maintainer-approved policy plus live smaller-model proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on prompt priority, bootstrap defaults, and core runtime policy, and steipete is the strongest recent history match for those surfaces.
